commit_message:
[DO NOT MERGE] Make GlobalScreenshot PendingIntents immutable

Mutable pending intents are a security risk. This change adds the
IMMUTABLE flag to all PendingIntents created in GlobalScreenshot.

Bug: 162738636
Test: manual
